body.message: Two studios in Business Bay, DAMAC Maison Prive at 6,000/month and Upside Living at 5,500/month. The 5,500 is the lowest in the area right now. On the rate question, we can't give an exact number for December but your rate from August 29 locks in for the first 3 months, and we'll confirm what the market looks like as December approaches. Which of the two are you leaning toward?
